Back in the day SaneGoat was perhaps a less volatile member of the community. He was arguably the first of all vigilant goats, and his impact on Voat back then cannot be ignored. This was before he called everyone with whom he interacted a shill, before he accused Voat, the userbase, and the admins of being corrupted, false, SJWs in opposition to freedom. He actually supported Voat and the admins, and endeavoured to point out areas where he thought Voat could do better. Consequently the community at large felt more warmly towards him, and this included Putt himself.

Below is a list of original links and archives of times when our beloved Putt trolled the living hell out of Sane, or just had an amusing exchange:

  • First we have a statement that Putt might by now regret. Namely, the time he called Sane his second favourite user. Archive here. This was said in response to some alleged PM from Sane, and although I don't believe the exact contents are known, we can assume by analyzing the context that it had to do with the Voat canary, which was in the process of being written (more on that shortly). This statement had the effect of Sane citing it weekly for several months to come. I have only one example of this, as comment histories can only be viewed back 20 pages, but I and I'm sure many others remember how often Sane brought up this single, likely half-serious statement by Putt. It was an amusing thing to observe.

  • Next is a memorable one. Adolf Puttler (+archive). Yes, the post by Sane that coined a term (not at all poorly received by much of the community), meant to depict Putt as some kind of ruthless leader. This was actually right around the time Sane snapped, so this is on the border of Old SaneGoat and the madman we know today. Still, Putt's jovial response at the top of the comments was amusing. The post also inspired the creation of an account, /u/AdolfPuttler, though this was perhaps done by Sane himself -- perhaps the beginning of his alt army.

  • I've linked to this next one before, but back when Putt was actively working on and training @VoatBot (and he may have begun doing so again recently), he had written into the poor bots behaviour a unique response to SaneGoat, one featuring turtles. @Failure also had a unique response at the time.

  • After Putt introduced a re-vamped user-blocking feature to Voat, Sane freaked out and coined the term shadowboxing. This seemed to amuse Putt, for immediately he created /v/ShadowBoxed (which tragically seems to have died), for which he is still the owner to this day. For maximum trolling of course, Putt had to make sure SaneGoat at least saw the subverse before the 'verse was allowed to die.

  • Next is just a time where Putt trolled us all (+archive), which fits well enough with the spirit of this post. The top comment of the thread illustrates well how effective the trolling was. Unfortunately there was no REEEing from SaneGoat in this thread.

  • Here is an example of Sane influencing a piece of Voat's history and writing our canary, which was actually used in the next announcement. Fortunately parts were removed before it reached the final form we still use today. Otherwise Voat would be at risk of being thought compromised the first time the admins forgot to post an announcement within a month-long period.

  • What is amusing though is that in the thread where Putt first used his canary Sane stated his love for Putt (+archive), and Putt graciously responded. A pleasant exchange, but it would do well to remember that the Sane of 8 months ago, at least behaviorally, was a different Sane from the one we know now.

  • Our final example is one open to interpretation, but I choose to believe it is as Sane portrays it simply for the comedic value. Here (or here) Sane rather randomly decides to call p0ssum a shill. Again, this was around that crucial period where Sane's behaviour changed, so him acting like this is not at all surprising. What is incredibly amusing, though, is that he claims that the unique badge that p0ssum possesses was given to him because p0ssum called out Sane on his bullshit. Now, as much as I love the notion of someone getting badged just for messing with Sane, p0ssum says it was this comment of his that earned him the badge (and it is a nice comment, I encourage you to give it a read), wherein he seems to call out all of us on our bullshit, not just Sane (although given the context of the situation Sane was the one perpetuating most of the bullshit, so I will gleefully continue to believe the badge was given because someone met Sane with logical argument.

That is all I have for now, but hiding within the recesses of Voat's older and less easily accessed content I am sure there are more humorous interactions between our beloved Putt and the most insane of so-called Sane goats.
